Name: Raxior's every color rideable dragons
Author: RaxiorKohvaliiDragxon
Description:
Hi this mod is a update to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5679]Dragon to Ride[/url] by Kyuya258369 this mod in addition to the original options adds 6 new basic colors and 2 special colors
additionally [size=3]the dragon's wing audio is available here [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5883]'Dragon to Ride' Wing audio[/url] thanks to [/size]BlueCynder

Original colors
[list=1]
[*]Black (originally called blank)
[*]Red

[/list]New Basic Colors
[list=1]
[*]Blue
[*]Yellow
[*]Green
[*]White
[*]Grey
[*]Pink
[*]Purple
[*]Orange
[/list]New Special Colors
[list=1]
[*]Ice White with ice bue highlights
[*]Raxior It's me! Blue with white trim markings
[/list]( I would like to make it clear that the dlc labeled images are a super smash bros joke the special colors are obtainable the same way as the basic colors simply go into mod options and select either Raxior or Ice)

Downloads.Description: this mod will replace the horse with a dragon with a color of your choice (chosen in the mod options)
